slug: EXT. CHINATOWN (SOLEDAD STREET), SALINAS, CA — DAWN
grid: 2.39:1 Dynamic Symmetry grid, normalized coords (0,0)=bottom-left, (1,1)=top-right. Eye points used: LL(0.30,0.33) LR(0.70,0.33) UL(0.30,0.66) UR(0.70,0.66); golden sections x=0.382/0.618.

shots.beat: Black screen. Voice-overs from the block.
shots.script: With the black black screen comes the first of the voice-overs.

dialogue.line: I got fifteen, who got fedi?
Somebody lemme hit their foil a couple times for three dollars.

shots.audio: Pre-dawn street room tone: distant freeway hiss, a shopping-cart wheel rattling, low overlapping voices. No music.
shots.editing: Hold black 6s. Voices panned slightly off-center so the block feels like it surrounds the audience before we see it. Fade up into 1-02 on the final word of V.O. #2.

shots.beat: Fade in. Track Paul heading south past the Suey Sing Building, head on a swivel. He answers V.O. #2.
shots.script: The opening shot fades in, tracking PAUL 23WM as he heads south, past The Suey Sing Building with his head on a swivel…
shots.camera: Smooth lateral gimbal track at Paul's fast walking pace, camera on the street side moving screen-right with him, slightly below his eye level.

blocking.focal_point: Paul's head turning, scanning the block
blocking.hotspot: left golden section x=0.382, head at y=0.66
blocking.coords: Paul's head held at (0.38, 0.66) for the full move; lead room open to screen-right
blocking.spiral: none — tracking shot holds subject fixed; background encampment slides along the outer arc
blocking.notes: Paul walks in the street along the curb, not on the sidewalk (producer note, Location Bible).

shots.set_design: Suey Sing façade runs as a baroque diagonal from upper-left to lower-right behind him; corner tents and the tarp two-unit structure pass in the background at y≈0.40; crumpled foil in the gutter along y=0.10.
shots.lighting: L1 Blue hour: cobalt pre-sunrise ambient, sodium streetlamps still burning amber as isolated pools; Paul passes through one amber pool mid-track.
shots.action: A young man walks fast and hunched-forward down the street along the curb, heading screen-right past a single-story stucco building lined with weathered tents and a large tarp-built shelter. His head swivels, scanning the sidewalk and across the street, listening. Without breaking stride he calls back over his shoulder.

dialogue.line: I'm 'bout to grab a ball. Gimme sec, I got you.

shots.audio: Footsteps on asphalt, distant laughter from the sidewalk group, a bottle clinking.
shots.editing: Fade from black over the first 1.5s. Hold the full track — this is the audience's guided entry into the block.

shots.beat: The sidewalk crew — Poochie, Moody, Gina, Belle, Izzy — seated with beers, happily listening to Sarah's drunk ramblings.
shots.script: POOCHIE 35BM, MOODY 35BM, GINA 25HF, and BELLE 30BF and IZZY 30HF are seated with beers, happily listening to SARAH'S 30WF drunk ramblings.
shots.camera: Static, camera at seated eye level, very slow push-in (5% over the shot).

blocking.coords: Sarah standing at (0.30, 0.62); the seated group arcs along the lower-right toward (0.80, 0.35) so their eyelines run up the sinister diagonal to her
blocking.spiral: Outer arc, bottom-right orientation — the seated crew sits along the arc, spiral coils into Sarah
blocking.notes: Diagonal sightlines, not a flat row. Moody beer in hand per bible.

shots.set_design: Tent in the building corner frames left edge; tarp structure fills right background, not competing with Sarah's hotspot.
shots.lighting: L1 Blue hour; warm practical glow from inside the tarp structure as the only warm accent.
shots.action: A group sits on crates and folding chairs on the sidewalk against the stucco wall, beers in hand, laughing easily as a tipsy woman standing among them tells an animated story with sweeping hand gestures. They lean toward her, grinning; one tips his head back mid-laugh.
shots.audio: Sarah's rambling as walla (unintelligible, sassy rhythm), group laughter.
shots.editing: Cutaway can overlap Paul's track audio. Group laughter continues under 1-07 to 1-13 as background (producer note).

shots.beat: Life at home: Gina going into and coming out of the tarp-built structure, putting things in and taking things out.
shots.script: Producer note (Location Bible): 'we want footage of them all going in and coming out of their home putting things into and grabbing things out of them.'
shots.camera: Locked-off, eye level. Nobody looks at camera.

blocking.focal_point: Gina's hands placing a folded blanket inside the shelter
blocking.coords: Shelter entrance at (0.70, 0.45); Gina enters from frame-left along the inner arc and stops at the entrance
blocking.notes: Domestic, ordinary gestures — this is a home, framed with dignity.

shots.set_design: Tarp structure's doorway flap is the frame's anchor; shopping cart parked beside it like a car in a driveway.
shots.lighting: L1 Blue hour.
shots.action: A woman lifts the flap of a large tarp-built shelter, sets a folded blanket inside with care, then steps back out carrying a jacket and pulls the flap closed behind her, like closing a front door.
shots.editing: B-roll pool. Use as cutaway anywhere in 1-02 to 1-06.

shots.beat: Perspective shot 1: the upper half of Soledad Street from Dorothy's up.
shots.script: We see a couple of perspective shots of the the upper-half (From Dorothy's Kitchen up) of Soledad Street.
shots.camera: Static, slightly elevated (head height on a crate), a slow 3-second tilt up from the gutter to the rooftops.

blocking.coords: Field occupies the right of frame from x=0.55 to 0.95; Moongate tower on the left edge reaching y=0.95
blocking.notes: Preserve the open field as intentional negative space — do not fill in, build over, or alter the gap (Scene Blocking drift log).

shots.set_design: Cars parked bumper to bumper on both sides of the street along the field. Foil glints in the gutter. Chairs, crates, bikes in disrepair, trash heaps and carts along the curb.
shots.lighting: L1 Blue hour; horizon behind the buildings beginning to lift to pale steel-blue.
shots.action: Establishing view down a Chinatown street at dawn: a seven-story apartment tower on the left, a single-story stucco building, then an open dirt field crowded with twenty weathered tents. Cars line both curbs bumper to bumper. People sit, stand and drift between tents.
shots.audio: Room tone, a far-off dog, the sidewalk crew's laughter faint.
shots.editing: Pair with 1-06 as the 'couple of perspective shots'.

shots.beat: Perspective shot 2: street-level detail — chairs, crates, bikes, carts, people hanging, selling, using. Foil everywhere.
shots.script: People selling and using drugs, and people hanging out. There's foil everywhere.
shots.framing: Low wide shot from curb height
shots.camera: Camera at gutter level, very slow push forward along the curb.

blocking.focal_point: A single crumpled foil ball in the foreground catching light
blocking.coords: Foreground foil at (0.30, 0.15); background figures soft along y=0.40–0.60
blocking.notes: Figures are background, soft-focus, non-identifiable — atmosphere, not spectacle.

shots.set_design: Foil along the lower-third line y=0.10 (Props addendum). A bike with no front wheel leans on a cart.
shots.lighting: L1 Blue hour; foil picks up the amber of the streetlamps.
shots.action: Low view along a gutter littered with small crumpled balls of foil glinting in the light. Behind, out of focus, people linger on the sidewalk among carts, crates and a broken bicycle; a figure sits bent forward, gently swaying.
shots.editing: Short. Cut on the lighter flick into 1-07.

shots.beat: Paul asks the block where it's at. Ends on a whip pan across the street.
shots.script: Paul asks the block. PAUL: I'm tryna spend a hundo, where it at?
shots.camera: Static for 3s, then a fast whip pan screen-left across the street (motion blur) for the final second.

blocking.coords: Paul's face at (0.30, 0.66), body angled toward screen-left (toward Dorothy's)
blocking.notes: He's turned outward to the whole block — open body, open need.

shots.set_design: Suey Sing wall soft behind him.
shots.lighting: L1 Blue hour, amber streetlamp as a rim on his hair.
shots.action: The young man stops at the curb, turns outward toward the whole street and calls out, arms half-raised. The camera then whips fast to the left across the street in a streak of motion blur.

dialogue.line: I'm tryna spend a hundo, where it at?

shots.audio: His voice carries and echoes slightly off the buildings.
shots.editing: Whip-pan match cut into 1-08: cut mid-blur.

shots.beat: Whip pan lands on Killa seated on a crate in the middle cubbyhole of Dorothy's.
shots.script: The shot whip pans across the street to where KILLA is seated on a crate, in the middle middle of cubbyhole. KILLA: You tried Feddietown?
shots.camera: Enters on the tail of a fast whip pan (motion blur), settles hard on Killa within 0.5s, then holds still.

blocking.coords: Killa seated at (0.70, 0.55), face at (0.70, 0.66), framed by the dark recessed cubbyhole
blocking.notes: Killa is still, the camera is the thing that moves — power sits still.

shots.set_design: Middle of three recessed cubbyhole entrances of the yellow stucco building frames him like a throne alcove; utility pole on frame-left edge.
shots.lighting: L1 Blue hour; the cubbyhole is in shade, a sliver of amber streetlamp catches his gold rings.
shots.action: The camera lands out of a fast whip pan on a tall slim man lounging on an upside-down milk crate in a recessed doorway, perfectly at ease. He speaks across the street without raising his voice.

dialogue.line: You tried Feddietown?

shots.editing: Receives the whip-pan match cut from 1-07.

shots.beat: Paul stops in his tracks and spins to Killa, face full of hope and desperation.
shots.script: The shot switches to one that catches PAUL stopping in tracks and spinning to KILLA with a face full of hope and desperation.
shots.camera: Static, at Paul's eye level.

blocking.coords: Paul spins into frame, face lands at (0.70, 0.66) looking screen-left toward Killa
blocking.notes: Eyeline screen-left matches Killa's screen-right placement in 1-08.

shots.set_design: Background falls off to soft blue.
shots.lighting: L1 Blue hour.
shots.action: The young man stops mid-stride and spins around, his face opening with sudden hope and need, eyes locked across the street.

dialogue.line: Not yet, why? Somebody over there gots some?

shots.editing: Cut on the spin.

shots.beat: Paul's POV of Dorothy's: a dozen people hanging, nodding, getting high around the other two cubbyholes. Killa sits alone.
shots.script: We see Dorothy's from PAUL'S perspective and there's a dozen or so people hanging, nodding, getting high in and around the other two cubbyholes. Killla sits alone.
shots.camera: POV, subtle handheld sway matching Paul's unsteady stance, looking across the street.

blocking.focal_point: Killa alone in the middle cubbyhole
blocking.coords: Killa at (0.62, 0.45); crowded cubbyholes at (0.25, 0.45) and (0.90, 0.45)
blocking.notes: Isolation by contrast: two crowded doorways bracket one empty-but-for-Killa doorway.

shots.set_design: Utility pole divides the frame at x=0.15; spiked yellow brick wall runs off both edges.
shots.lighting: L1 Blue hour.
shots.action: View across the street at a two-story Spanish-style building with three recessed doorways. The two outer doorways are crowded with a dozen people leaning, sitting, bodies folded forward and gently swaying. In the middle doorway one man sits alone on a crate.
shots.audio: Soft murmur from across the street.
shots.editing: Paul's POV — keep short enough that the audience reads the geography of power: Killa alone.

shots.beat: Killa shakes his head no.
shots.script: KILLA (shaking his head): Naw. There ain't been none out here all night.
shots.camera: Static, slightly below Killa's eye level.

blocking.coords: Killa's face at (0.70, 0.66), eyeline screen-right toward Paul

shots.set_design: Dark cubbyhole behind him.
shots.lighting: L1 Blue hour.
shots.action: The man in the doorway slowly shakes his head, unhurried, almost amused.

dialogue.line: Naw. There ain't been none out here all night.

shots.beat: Paul deflates and drops his head in defeat. Holds, crushed, for a drawn-out moment.
shots.script: MALE ADDICT #1 deflates and drops his head in defeat. 'Fuck man.' He stands there crushed, with his head hanging, for drawn-out moment…
shots.camera: Low angle, just below his chin line (Cinematography Bible: low, intimate angles for vulnerable moments). Static — the camera lingers through the held beat.

blocking.coords: Head sinks from (0.30, 0.55) to (0.30, 0.33) over the beat
blocking.spiral: Head's drop traces the inner coil of a bottom-left spiral
blocking.notes: His drop moves the focal point downward into the lower-left eye — the frame itself sinks with him.

shots.set_design: Sky above him, negative space weighted overhead.
shots.lighting: L1 Blue hour; he's out of the streetlamp pool now — cool, unlit, alone.
shots.action: The young man's shoulders sag and his head drops. He stands in a held pose, head hanging, completely deflated, breathing shallowly.

dialogue.line: Fuck man.

shots.audio: His exhale; the distant group laughter continues, indifferent.
shots.editing: Let this run long. Do not cut the hold.

shots.beat: Paul, sad and hurt: he's sick; should have bought the dime off his neighbor.
shots.script: MALE ADDICT: Fuck man Im sick. I shoulda just bought that dime off my neighbor.
shots.camera: Static, eye level, very slow push-in.

blocking.coords: Eyes at (0.30, 0.66); arms wrapped around himself in lower frame

shots.set_design: Background fully soft.
shots.lighting: L1 Blue hour, faint sheen of sweat catching the cool light.
shots.action: Close on the young man's face, a light sheen of sweat on his forehead, arms wrapped around himself against a chill, eyes watery and pained as he speaks quietly, half to himself.

dialogue.line: Fuck man, I'm sick. I shoulda just bought that dime off my neighbor.

shots.beat: Killa, smirking and unsympathetic, reaches into the front of his pants for his sack and pitches the blues. Paul has crossed to the curb in front of Dorothy's.
shots.script: There's a smirkish, unsympathetic, expression on Killa's face, as he reaches down into the front of his pants for his sack. KILLA: You betta get you some of deez blue…
shots.camera: Static, camera at street level low beside Paul.

blocking.notes: Scene Blocking Bible worked example (Male Addict #1 & Killa): Killa visually above despite being seated — reinforces his control. Blocking decision: Paul has crossed the street to the curb in front of Dorothy's between 1-13 and 1-14 so the transaction can happen at arm's length.

shots.set_design: Cubbyhole's step raises Killa above street level; utility pole at x=0.15 separates the two men's worlds.
shots.lighting: L1 Blue hour.

dialogue.line: You betta get you some of deez blue, for you fuck around and shit on yourself or somethin'.

shots.editing: Editing coverage gate: this is the scene's only Paul–Killa two-shot; keep it as the master for 1-15/1-16 inserts.

shots.script: The shot switches to PAUL as his expression goes thoughtful and he reaches into his pocket for his money.

shots.audio: Tiny click of pills in the palm.

shots.beat: Headlights of a vehicle turning onto the street light up Killa's face; he turns, eyes go big, whistles appreciatively.
shots.script: The headlights from a vehicle turning onto the street, light up Killa's face, and when KILLA turns toward it his eyes go big and he whistles appreciatively.
shots.camera: Static.

shots.lighting: L2 Intrusion: hard white headlights rake across his face left-to-right — the only hard light in the scene. Deliberate departure from soft-light standard (see Lighting CRR).

shots.audio: Deep engine purr approaching, the whistle.
shots.editing: Cut on the head turn into 1-18.

shots.audio: Engine purr, tires crunching over grit, then idle.
shots.editing: Dialogue is off-screen (back of Killa's head).

shots.beat: The camera finds Ruby standing out front of the Moongate, smoking a cigarette in her robe.
shots.script: Finally the camera finds RUBY STEEVES 60NAF standing out front of The Moon gate, smoking a cigarette in her robe.

Yeah, you look like you seent a ghost, Ms. Ruby.

shots.script: Ruby exhales a wearied-breath. RUBY: I had a dream that Dances overdosed and I been up ever since.
